plan.title: main red: styleguide-conformance spec times out since the Skills page redesign (a443ff0619a, index.css)

references.label: PAN-4733 (structural browser-lane follow-up, out of scope)

narratives.Problem: tests/e2e/styleguide-conformance.spec.ts:417, the six-route it 'renders shared primitives on Pipeline, Board, Command Deck, and Agents routes', timed out at 45 s on both attempts in main CI runs #12510 (a443ff0619a) and #12514 (68258a2c4bd). The issue blames a443ff0619a's index.css, but the spec's styleguide-empty-index-css Vite plugin replaces index.css with a two-rule stub, so that CSS never reaches the test. The real cause: the it opens six routes, each a fresh-context full load of the unbundled Vite dev app (~6-7 s each on a slow CI runner), inside one 45 s budget. Since at least 2026-10-24 it has timed out on the first attempt on every slow runner and passed only on the retry, and the retry time has grown from 35 s to 44 s. #12510 and #12514 are the first runs where the retry also crossed 45 s.
narratives.Proposal: Split the six-route it into six its, one per route (Pipeline, Board, Command Deck, Agents Live, Agents History, issue drawer), each copying its block's assertions verbatim and keeping the 45_000 per-it budget. No timeout value changes and nothing is quarantined. Document the browser-spec page-load budget in docs/TESTING.md. The structural move of browser specs out of the unit shards stays with PAN-4733.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to any timeout value: per-it 45_000, renderPoll { timeout: 10_000, interval: 100 }, beforeAll 30_000
- No entry in scripts/flaky-quarantine.txt and no .skip, .only or skipIf
- No edit to src/dashboard/frontend/src/index.css, src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/SkillsList.tsx or src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/skills/*; the Skills page redesign stays as shipped
- No move or rename of tests/e2e/styleguide-conformance.spec.ts, no tests/e2e/browser/ lane, no vitest.config.ts or .github/workflows change (PAN-4733)
- No shared BrowserContext, Vite server.warmup, it.each parametrisation or client-side route navigation
- No change to the other two its in the spec ('agents page opens Live, ...' and 'enforces visual contracts ...')

autoDecisions.summary: Treat the issue's root-cause hypothesis (a443ff0619a's index.css) as disproved and fix the real cause instead of editing CSS or the Skills components.
autoDecisions.rationale: The spec's styleguide-empty-index-css plugin (spec lines 381-395) replaces index.css with a stub, the Skills panel renders no groups under the spec's {} fetch mock, and CI history shows the same it needing (retry x1) on slow runners since 2026-10-24, before a443ff0619a existed. The issue's acceptance (spec passes, Skills redesign intact) and constraints (no timeout raise, no quarantine) are still met, so this is not a contradiction that requires halting.

autoDecisions.summary: Split the six-route it into exactly one it per route, keeping 45_000 on each.
autoDecisions.rationale: Measured cost is one cold load plus ~6-7 s per route on a slow CI runner. One route per it gives each page load the full 45 s budget the file already uses, names the failing route in the test title, and needs no timeout change. Two routes per it would fit today but leaves less headroom as the app grows.

autoDecisions.summary: Do not use a shared browser context or Vite server.warmup.
autoDecisions.rationale: Measured locally on two pinned cores: a shared context saved ~10% per route and warmup saved ~1 s on the cold load. Neither is needed once the it is split, and both add code.

autoDecisions.summary: Leave the structural fix (serial browser lane, file move) to PAN-4733.
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-4733 is open and owns moving all four browser specs to tests/e2e/browser/*.slow.test.ts. Doing it here would duplicate and conflict with that plan.
